title: Best robot vacuum deal: Save $300 on the Dreame Matrix10 Ultra
excerpt: This premium cleaner has dropped below $1,500 for a limited time.
content_html:
SAVE $300: As of July 27, the Dreame Matrix10 Ultra robot vacuum and mop is on sale for $1,499.99 at Amazon. That's $300 cheaper than the list price of $1,799.99.

Credit: Dreame

$1,499.99 at Amazon
$1,799.99 Save $300

Released just last year, Dreame's Matrix10 Ultra is a premium robot vacuum pick for those who want a cleaner that can handle both vacuuming and mopping. If it's something you've had on your radar but have been waiting for the price to dip before buying, now is a great time to make a move.

Amazon has knocked $300 off this cleaner's price tag, dropping it from $1,799.99 to $1,499.99, though it won't be discounted for long. The retailer has slapped a "limited time deal" tag on it, so the countdown has begun to take advantage of this offer.

If it's felt too much to keep on top of cleaning this summer, the Dreame Matrix10 Ultra is a mighty helpful machine to have around. In terms of vacuuming power, it boasts 30,000Pa Vormax suction to clear up your carpets and harder surfaces. Plus, it has a HyperStream detangling DuoBrush that keeps hair from clogging it up and slowing it down.

Mashable Trend Report

When it comes to mopping, this cleaner also has a Multi-Mop Switching Dock. According to the store page, this auto-selects the right mop for each area in your home, helping to prevent cross-contamination. On top of that, navigating your home is a breeze for this model. Not only does it feature obstacle-avoidance technology, but it also has dual retractable legs that can push through up to 3.15-inch steps.

Mashable's Leah Stodart experienced this system with a different model and wrote: "The use case felt quite limited. Actual stair climbing is still out of the question, but it could be helpful if your floors have any height changes, or if you need a robot vacuum to cross sliding door tracks."

If the Dreame Matrix10 Ultra robot vacuum and mop has caught your attention, don't miss out on this great deal at Amazon.

content_html_zh:
节省 300 美元：自 7 月 27 日起，Dreame Matrix10 Ultra 扫地机器人和拖把机器人在亚马逊上的售价为 1,499.99 美元。 这比标价 1,799.99 美元便宜 300 美元。

图片来源：梦想

亚马逊 $1,499.99 $1,799.99 节省 300 美元

Dreame 的 Matrix10 Ultra 于去年发布，是一款优质机器人真空吸尘器，适合那些想要一款既能吸尘又能拖地的吸尘器的人。 如果您已经注意到了它，但一直在等待价格下跌才购买，那么现在是采取行动的好时机。

亚马逊已将这款清洁剂的价格标签下调了 300 美元，从 1,799.99 美元降至 1,499.99 美元，不过折扣不会持续很长时间。 零售商已经给它贴上了“限时优惠”标签，因此倒计时已经开始利用这一优惠。

如果今年夏天感觉清洁工作太费力，那么 Dreame Matrix10 Ultra 是一款非常有用的机器。 在吸尘功率方面，它拥有 30,000Pa Vormax 吸力，可清理地毯和较硬的表面。 此外，它还具有 HyperStream 缠结 DuoBrush，可防止头发堵塞并减慢速度。

可混搭趋势报告

在拖地方面，这款吸尘器还配备了多功能拖把切换底座。 根据商店页面，它会自动为您家中的每个区域选择合适的拖把，有助于防止交叉污染。 最重要的是，对于这个模型来说，在家里导航是一件轻而易举的事。 它不仅具有避障技术，而且还具有双伸缩腿，可以推动高达 3.15 英寸的台阶。

Mashable 的 Leah Stodart 通过不同的模型体验了这个系统，并写道：“用例感觉非常有限。 实际爬楼梯仍然是不可能的，但如果您的地板有任何高度变化，或者如果您需要机器人真空吸尘器来穿过滑动门轨道，这可能会有所帮助。”

如果 Dreame Matrix10 Ultra 扫地机器人和拖地机器人引起了您的注意，请不要错过亚马逊的这项超值优惠。
